says: The program client adds a view per pid and never removes one, so each life a tile ever showed keeps its last view in memory until the window closes.
proof: rg -n views next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Client.ts shows the only write at line 210, views: {...c.views, [pid]: shown}, and no delete; WindowMachine.ts never drops a key from client.views either.
cost: A long-lived tab on a program that restarts often grows by one view per restart.
